people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “Listen to me, O Jacob, and Israel my called: I am he. I am the first. I am also the last.
translations.bsb: Listen to Me, O Jacob, and Israel, whom I have called: I am He; I am the first, and I am the last.
translations.kjv: Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Israel, my called; I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.
translations.asv: Hearken unto me, O Jacob, and Israel my called: I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.
